capabilities: Renders every Mermaid block as an auto-fitted card with ELK layout
Zooms and pans diagrams inline and in a resizable expanded view
Exports diagrams as PNG, SVG or copied image and source
Applies built-in or custom themes, per diagram via directives
Switches layout engine between ELK and Dagre globally or per diagram
disambiguation: Not a Mermaid syntax cleaner or formatter; it re-renders Mermaid blocks with its own layout engine, card chrome and themes.
extras: Desktop only and requires Obsidian 1.14.4+; ships its own Mermaid renderer so main.js is a few MB; only one Mermaid-renderer plugin can be active, and disabling it restores Obsidian's rendering.
intentEvidence: Right is Obsidian's own Mermaid rendering.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Mermaid rendering pins diagrams to the reading column with a basic layout and theme-dependent colours, so large diagrams overflow the note and look inconsistent.
summary: Mermaid renderer that replaces Obsidian's diagram blocks with clean auto-fitted cards, ELK layout, zoom and pan, PNG/SVG export and themes.
